details: a decode error deep in a document no longer costs the square of its path: the path was rebuilt at every level as the error returned (2,500 levels of 1 KB keys: 432 ms, now 15 ms, against 1 ms to decode the document). Error paths are unchanged.
changelog: - Security (std/json, native, LLVM and wasm backends): a decode error deep in a document no longer costs the square of its path: the path was rebuilt at every level as the error returned (2,500 levels of 1 KB keys: 432 ms, now 15 ms, against 1 ms to decode the document). Error paths are unchanged.
